title: Replace shopping list notes model with String
description: Update `ShoppingListDocument` to store user-editable notes as `String` instead of preserved `[Block]` content, and remove the obsolete preservation type if nothing else still references it.
acceptance_criteria: Any initializer/default usage compiles with the new field type.
The old preserved-free-text `Block` type is removed if it has no remaining callers; otherwise only unrelated usages are left intact.
No parser or renderer logic still assumes `notes` is a block collection.
